messages:
mario_acme: Hi, accepted the invite again but still hitting 403 when I try to edit project billing. Logged out/in, cleared cache. Any ideas?

jess_support: Thanks for the report — can you confirm org id and the account email you used to accept? Also did you accept via SSO (Okta) or the email link?

mario_acme: Org 4490, mario@acme.com, accepted via Okta SSO link about 2m ago. Chrome. Error msg screenshot: https://acme.screens/ss (attached)

jess_support: Escalating to infra. @alex_engineer can you take a look? User accepted invite but console still returns 403.

alex_engineer: Checking logs. Can you paste the full API error body if possible? route called?

mario_acme: The UI shows "403 Permission denied: missing role project.editor" when clicking Edit -> Billing.

alex_engineer: Running quick membership check against authz service...

deploy-bot: SCIM sync job (okta-sync) last run: 1719123000, status: FAILED (502 upstream response)

alex_engineer: That explains it — SCIM failed during the IdP group rename window. Invite accepted but group->role binding not created. I'll trigger a manual resync for this user.

alex_engineer: Kicking off: `authz-resync --org 4490 --user mario@acme.com` (manual path while we investigate batch retry).

deploy-bot: job queued: resync-7744. Estimated runtime: ~10s

alex_engineer: Resync finished, authz-tool shows binding added: mario@acme.com -> role:project.editor on project 4490.

jess_support: Can you try again now, @mario_acme?

mario_acme: Tried — can edit billing now, looks fixed :tada: Thanks!

jess_support: Closing loop with customer. Root cause: transient SCIM 502 from IdP during a group rename caused the accepted SSO invite to not create role bindings. Action items: add alert for SCIM 5xx, implement retry/backoff on sync failures, and document manual resync steps.

sophie_devex: I'll write a KB: "Invite accepted but permissions missing (SSO/SCIM)" with repro steps and the manual resync command + console fallback.

alex_engineer: Filed INF-2231 for automated retries + alerting. We'll also backfill metrics for scim 5xx during the rename window and follow up in the morning.

jess_support: Thanks everyone — marking resolved for now. If anything recurs please reopen this thread.
